name: Shepherd Hare
description: A rabbit-like animal that runs along narrow side paths.

name: Pilot Hare
description: A rare hare associated with sunny weather.

name: Woodland Pteryx
description: A forest bird whose anatomy resembles ancient avian species.

name: Forest Pteryx
description: An uncommon forest bird distinguished by its bright crown and plumage.

name: Cobalt Flutterfly
description: A butterfly with conspicuous cobalt-blue wings.

name: Phantom Flutterfly
description: A very rare, vividly coloured butterfly associated with sunny conditions.

name: Climbing Joyperch
description: An amphibian whose calls become noticeable in the rain.

name: Forest Gekko
description: A tree-dwelling lizard that hunts insects around brightmoss.

name: Wildspire Gekko
description: A desert lizard commonly found near ant hills.

name: Gloom Gekko
description: A brightly marked lizard that lives in caves and other shaded areas.

name: Moonlight Gekko
description: A rare lizard that uses its glowing tail to attract prey.

name: Vaporonid
description: A spider that makes exceptionally large webs.

name: Scavantula
description: A scavenging spider often gathered near bones and rotting meat.

name: Revolture
description: A scavenging bird that follows large monsters and feeds on carcasses.

name: Blissbill
description: A seed- and fruit-eating bird accustomed to the presence of people.

name: Omenfly
description: An insect whose luminous tail changes colour when danger approaches.

name: Augurfly
description: A rare insect that emerges in rainy weather.

name: Scalebat
description: A small, bat-like wyvern adapted to dark caves.

name: Dung Beetle
description: A beetle that rolls monster dung into balls usable as slinger ammunition.

name: Bomb Beetle
description: A beetle that rolls stones containing explosive slinger material.

name: Pink Parexus
description: A widespread fish with protective spines on its fins.

name: Great Pink Parexus
description: An unusually large Pink Parexus; the larger form is recorded separately from the standard fish.

name: Burst Arowana
description: A fish whose scales are used to make gunpowder.

name: Great Burst Arowana
description: An unusually large Burst Arowana; the larger form is recorded separately from the standard fish.

name: Bomb Arowana
description: A more volatile arowana whose scales are used for stronger gunpowder.

name: Great Bomb Arowana
description: An unusually large Bomb Arowana; the larger form is recorded separately from the standard fish.

name: Elegant Coralbird
description: The pink female coralbird, coloured by its coral diet.

name: Dapper Coralbird
description: The much rarer male coralbird.

name: Andangler
description: A luminous aquatic predator that attracts Flying Meduso.

name: Downy Crake
description: An exceptionally rare, soft-feathered bird that rides on other animals.

notes: Search the backs of host animals. Use a Ghillie Mantle and aim the capture net before approaching.

name: Bristly Crake
description: An exceptionally rare bird with stiff plumage, found riding on host animals.

notes: Search the backs of host animals in the Vale or Recess. Approach quietly with a Ghillie Mantle.

name: Hopguppy
description: A fish that skips over water and glides using its broad pectoral fins.

name: Petricanths
description: An elusive living fossil previously believed extinct.

name: Paratoad
description: A toad whose defensive gas can paralyse hunters and large monsters.

name: Sleeptoad
description: A toad whose defensive gas induces sleep.

name: Nitrotoad
description: A toad that releases an explosive secretion when disturbed.

name: Wiggler
description: A shy coral dweller that becomes easier to approach when the hunter crouches.

notes: Crouch to reduce the chance of frightening the group underground.

name: Wiggler Queen
description: A rare, larger wiggler associated with moonlit nights.

name: Vigorwasp
description: A flying insect that carries a restorative nectar sac.

name: Giant Vigorwasp
description: A larger vigorwasp whose released nectar leaves a healing mist.

name: Flying Meduso
description: A floating Coral Highlands creature carried by strong air currents.

name: Carrier Ant
description: An ant capable of carrying an assortment of materials.

name: Hercudrome
description: A large horned beetle found at a limited set of forest trees.

name: Gold Hercudrome
description: A golden beetle that appears after dark.

name: Prism Hercudrome
description: A rainbow-coloured beetle most associated with dawn and dusk.

name: Emperor Hopper
description: A large grasshopper with fast, erratic jumps.

name: Tyrant Hopper
description: A carrion-eating relative of the herbivorous Emperor Hopper.

name: Flashfly
description: A flying insect whose bright defensive flash can blind monsters.

name: Grandfather Mantagrell
description: A large floating creature sustained by air currents.

name: Iron Helmcrab
description: A muddy-terrain crab that carries hard objects and piercing slinger pods.

name: Soldier Helmcrab
description: A scavenging crab that moves in groups through the Rotten Vale.

name: Emerald Helmcrab
description: A rare, jewel-coloured crab associated with poor weather.

name: Whetfish
description: A fish whose hardened dorsal fin can sharpen weapons.

name: Great Whetfish
description: An unusually large Whetfish; the larger form is recorded separately from the standard fish.

name: Gastronome Tuna
description: A voracious fish that may carry swallowed items.

name: Great Gastronome Tuna
description: An unusually large Gastronome Tuna; the larger form is recorded separately from the standard fish.

name: King Marlin
description: A large, sword-jawed fish that approaches the shore in warmer daytime conditions.

name: Great King Marlin
description: An unusually large King Marlin; the larger form is recorded separately from the standard fish.

name: Goldenfish
description: A gold-coloured cave fish with valuable scales.

name: Great Goldenfish
description: An unusually large Goldenfish; the larger form is recorded separately from the standard fish.

name: Platinumfish
description: An elusive cave fish with highly valuable, platinum-like scales.

name: Great Platinumfish
description: An unusually large Platinumfish; the larger form is recorded separately from the standard fish.

name: Goldenfry
description: A small fish with valuable golden scales.

name: Great Goldenfry
description: An unusually large Goldenfry; the larger form is recorded separately from the standard fish.

name: Sushifish
description: A nutritious fish whose scales have restorative uses.

name: Great Sushifish
description: An unusually large Sushifish; the larger form is recorded separately from the standard fish.

name: Gunpowderfish
description: A fish whose scales supply explosive crafting material.

name: Great Gunpowderfish
description: An unusually large Gunpowderfish; the larger form is recorded separately from the standard fish.

name: Gold Scalebat
description: A golden-scaled relative adapted to the Caverns of El Dorado.

name: Gold Helmcrab
description: A gold-coloured crab that collects Dragon Pods.

name: Shiny Gold Helmcrab
description: A particularly lustrous relative of the Gold Helmcrab.

name: Copper Calappa
description: A crab that feeds on gold fragments shed by Kulve Taroth.

name: Gold Calappa
description: An older calappa with an especially golden shell.

name: Tsuchinoko
description: A very rare serpent-like creature found in the golden caverns.

name: Cactuar
description: A cactus-like visitor from Eorzea with a powerful needle defence.

name: Cactuar Cutting
description: A small, fast-moving cactus-like creature from Eorzea.

name: Flowering Cactuar Cutting
description: An uncommon cactuar cutting distinguished by its flower.

name: Nekker
description: A creature from the Witcher world, encountered while scavenging alone.

name: Stonebill
description: A tundra bird that calls loudly when a large monster approaches.

name: Rime Beetle
description: A beetle that rolls snow into a deposit of crystalburst.

name: Pearlspring Macaque
description: A small Hoarfrost Reach monkey that warms itself in hot springs.

name: Goldspring Macaque
description: A rare, golden-furred relative of the Pearlspring Macaque.

name: Crowned Prawn
description: A bioluminescent, bug-like cave creature found around melting ice.

name: Moon Slug
description: A floating creature that leaves its cave shelter to feed at night.

notes: Shelters in caves by day; floats outside while feeding at night.

name: Duffel Penguin
description: A flocking tundra bird insulated by thick, fluffy plumage.

name: Arrowhead Gekko
description: A triangular-headed lizard that hunts insects near fruit-bearing trees.

name: Blue Diva
description: A rare songbird whose striking call attracts mates.

name: Sealord's Crestfish
description: A deep-water fish that rises to feed at night, using luminous fins as a lure.

name: Glass Parexus
description: A cold-water fish with an almost transparent body.

name: Great Glass Parexus
description: An unusually large Glass Parexus; the larger form is recorded separately from the standard fish.

name: Wintermoon Nettle
description: An exceptionally rare floating creature associated with large nighttime Moon Slug gatherings.

notes: Look near the Hoarfrost Reach summit above Area 14. Large Moon Slug gatherings are a useful clue.

name: Moly
description: A small, burrowing creature native to the Guiding Lands.

notes: Use a Ghillie Mantle and avoid sprinting toward the burrows.

name: Mossy Moly
description: The green, moss-covered moly associated with forest habitat.

name: Rocky Moly
description: A moly with a protective helmet and strong digging ability.

name: Fluffy Moly
description: A moly with a fluffy coat and rounded front claws.

name: Spiny Moly
description: A sharp-clawed moly adapted to effluvial habitat.

name: Rowdy Moly
description: A red-furred moly whose hard claws can cut through rock.

name: Frosty Moly
description: A white-furred moly adapted to snowy habitat.
